task.description: Design and/or refine test specifications for EXT-05 sub-process support. Ensure tests cover: parent WAITING after SUB_PROCESS activation, child copy-on-start variable isolation, merge-on-child-complete behavior per EE-09, CHILD_PROCESS_ERROR and CHILD_PROCESS_CANCELLED propagation with required IDs, and non-cascading parent cancellation. Add or adjust spec file(s) under tests/specs and ensure runnable test coverage mapping is explicit for unit/integration suites.
acceptance_criteria: Test spec covers all EXT-05 acceptance criteria
Edge cases from EXT-05 requirement are represented
Test mapping to existing/new test files is explicit and executable

result.summary: Test specs and executable EXT-05 coverage are complete. Added tests/specs/EXT-05.md with full acceptance-criteria and edge-case traceability, and expanded integration coverage for copy-on-start variable isolation, merge-on-child-complete behavior per EE-09, CHILD_PROCESS_ERROR and CHILD_PROCESS_CANCELLED propagation with required IDs, and parent-cancel non-cascade behavior.
